orbit.env.title: Environment & Simulation Conditions
reason.camera.scanning: In imaging window with power & thermal nominal: scanning target and filling onboard buffer.
reason.camera.overflow: In imaging window, but onboard buffer is 100% full: camera still draws power and discards new data (not transmitted to Earth).
reason.camera.waitWindow: Command is ON, waiting for imaging window: shutter parked, zero scan VFX, zero instrumentW draw.
reason.camera.coldLocked: Command remains ON, but Cold Stress reached 2: camera optics locked until warmed in shadow with Heater ON.
reason.camera.safeOverride: SAFE Mode active: camera parked in protective pose; previous command saved.
reason.camera.damaged: Science instrument severely damaged (severity 1.0): unable to capture imagery.
reason.camera.off: Camera switch is OFF: lens shutter closed and parked.
reason.tx.transmitting: Over ground station with stored data: antenna aimed and transmitting buffer to Earth.
reason.tx.storm: Transmitting during solar storm: radio link degraded (0.5× rate controlled by simulation logic).
reason.tx.waitWindow: Command is ON, waiting for ground station pass: antenna in standby, zero radio emission.
reason.tx.emptyBuffer: In station pass window, but onboard buffer is 0 Mb: transmitter automatically idles without drawing transmitterW.
reason.tx.safeOverride: SAFE Mode active: radio downlink halted; untransmitted data preserved in buffer.
reason.tx.damaged: Comms subsystem severely damaged (severity 1.0): downlink unavailable.
reason.tx.off: Transmitter switch is OFF: antenna returned to calm standby; data stays in buffer.
reason.heater.heating: In eclipse shadow with Heater enabled: thermal strips active, drawing heaterW and reducing cold stress.
reason.heater.forcedSafe: Forced ON by SAFE Mode during shadow: protecting instrument from cold lock.
reason.heater.waitShadow: Heater enabled, waiting for eclipse shadow: no heaterW consumed in sunlight.
reason.heater.damaged: Thermal subsystem damaged (severity 1.0): heater circuit unavailable.
reason.heater.offShadow: Heater OFF in shadow: zero heaterW draw; cold stress accumulates (+1 per eclipse).
reason.safe.active: SAFE Mode ON: camera & transmitter stopped, available heater enabled, base systems on, solar panels charging in sun.
reason.safe.off: Normal operations: individual camera, transmitter & heater switch commands active.
reason.common.noPower: Battery depleted (0 Wh) or bus destroyed: all operations and visual effects halted immediately.
reason.common.missionEnded: Mission completed/terminated: all working effects stopped.
export.packUnavailable: The complete viewer ZIP is unavailable. Run the documented build, or download individual models / the asset-only ZIP. The extracted ZIP intentionally does not contain another copy of itself.
help.title: Asset Workshop Manual & Game Integration
help.mouse: Viewport Controls: Left-drag to orbit, Right-drag (or Shift+drag) to pan, Wheel/Pinch to zoom. Keys: [R] Reset view, [F] Fit model, [Space] Play/Pause, [0] Bind pose, [W] Wireframe, [M] Mounts.
help.animations: Animations: All clips are real glTF keyframe tracks (bone/node rotation & translation). Locomotion clips (idle, run, float_idle, float_move) are in-place without drift; the game drives actor coordinates.
help.downloads: Exports: Every Download button exports from clean bind pose with all clips and PBR materials embedded in binary GLB. No external textures or CDN links required.
help.react: React / Three.js Integration: Use tools/asset-workshop/src/adapter/import-and-animate.ts (also included in ZIP under examples/). Keep game rules in src/core/; the renderer only reflects state and dispatches player actions.
